Data.title: Number Of Full-Time University Students Enrolment By Sex, Annual
Data.footnote: Refers to National University of Singapore, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore Management University, Singapore Institute of Technology, Singapore University of Technology & Design and Singapore University of Social Sciences. Enrolment figures refer to full-time first degree only. Courses are classified according to course content of the highest weighting. Sum of the components may not add up to the total as there are courses whose main field of study is not elsewhere classifiable.
